title: Twin study on risk and resilience factors of mental disorders
summary: TWIN STR2ESS examines how genetic and environmental factors jointly influence mental health and why some individuals develop mental disorders while others remain healthy. It also investigates how mental health and emotional skills are related within families. TWIN STR2ESS studies mental health in twins using laboratory and real-life assessments, questionnaires, stress tasks, biological samples, and digital and speech data. This allows genetic, biological, and environmental factors to be captured in both daily life and controlled settings. The aim is to better understand risk factors and develop more effective long-term prevention strategies.
